clusters.description: Outliers that didn't fall into any style cluster.

Stark, limited-palette graphic scenes — ink line work, white silhouettes on black, and duotone/halftone or desaturated gritty cityscapes, unified by heavy contrast and bold figure-and-environment composition.
Explosive radial motion lines bursting from a center; purple/magenta shards on black and white.
Dense single-colour particle clouds forming a soft volume against a flat background.
Thin grayscale line and wireframe geometry — swirling curves and lattices on black.
Clean glossy 3D objects lit with saturated cyan/blue neon gradients on a dark stage.
Rounded multicoloured dot particles massing into a loose rainbow cloud on black.
Soft matte clay-render objects, gentle shadows, minimal neutral backgrounds.
Minimal translucent glass/gradient geometry floating on a plain neutral-grey ground.
Sharp angular confetti flakes scattered in bright colour across a dark field.
Flat cel-shaded interiors and scenes with bold outlines and a single colour wash.
Translucent liquid/water simulations, blue tones on a soft monochrome ground.
Crinkled holographic foil abstractions — iridescent blue, pink and pearl sheen.
Voxel and pixelated forms — blocky cubes assembling into nature and objects.
Soft oil-filter landscapes — sea, sky and grass with smooth painterly blending.
Thick palette-knife oil strokes in radial/abstract arrangements on white.
Dabbed impressionist brushwork, foliage and trees in mottled colour.
Lush stylized painted nature scenes — flower meadows and tree groves, warm light.
Semi-photoreal 3D terrain renders — water, rock and moss with naturalistic light.
